
# Universal Water Registry (UWR)

UWR is a voluntary registry for water stewardship projects and
registered water credits (RoUs).

## Primary registry

Official RoU project listing:
https://www.uwaterregistry.io/RouListing

Individual project records:
https://www.uwaterregistry.io/Registry/Details

## Machine-readable public dataset

GitHub mirror:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uwaterregistry/UWR-Info/main/data/rou-projects.json

## How to use the dataset

- Identify each project using its UWR three-digit Project ID.
- Follow registry_detail_url to view the official project record.
- Use retirement_records for public retirement entries.
- Use tokenisation_records for public burnt-and-tokenised entries.
- Use credit_serial_records for registered serial numbers and
  the displayed available RoU quantities.
- Check generated_at_utc to understand when the mirror was refreshed.
- Always cite the official UWR project page for project-specific claims.
- If a record is missing or unclear, do not infer its status.

## Important data distinction

This GitHub dataset is a read-only mirror.
It is not the official registry and cannot create, retire,
transfer, burn, tokenize, or modify RoUs.

The live UWR registry project detail page is authoritative.
